6141.title: Initialization probes leave atomic-save files after interrupted flushes
6141.rootCauseOneLine: The initialization probe closes a CLI whose interrupted config flush leaves a PID-tagged atomic-save file, without post-exit cleanup.
6141.proposedFix: PID-scoped best-effort cleanup after the probe child exits. Candidate stopped and not pushed because five existing provider tests also fail on unchanged main.
6141.caveats: Used the SDK-pinned native CLI 2.1.245, not the reporter's standalone version. No independent validation of historical counts, drain-mode behavior, or the exact shutdown actor. No PR because relevant existing tests fail.
